overview: From Executive Producer Mike Flanagan and Director Chris Stuckmann. This supernatural horror follows a film crew as they uncover a new lead in a woman's obsessive search for her missing sister, which takes her into a terrifying mystery at the hands of an unknown evil.

title: Sijjin
overview: Öznur’s love for her cousin devolves into manic jealousy when he gets married so she unknowingly unleashes a deadly curse to win his affections.

title: Sing Street
overview: In 1985, a Dublin teenager forms a rock 'n' roll band to win the heart of an aspiring model.

title: Soul
overview: What is it that makes you...YOU? Pixar Animation Studios' feature film SOUL introduces Joe Gardner (voice of Jamie Foxx) - a middle-school band teacher who gets the chance of a lifetime to play at the best jazz club in town. But one small misstep takes him from the streets of New York City to The Great Before - a fantastical place where new souls get their personalities, quirks and interests before they go to Earth. Determined to return to his life, Joe teams up with a precocious soul, 22 (voice of Tina Fey), who has never understood the appeal of the human experience. As Joe desperately tries to show 22 what's great about living, he may just discover the answers to some of life's most important questions. Directed by Academy Award® winner Pete Docter ("Inside Out," "Up"), co-directed by Kemp Powers ("One Night in Miami"), written by Kemp Powers & Mike Jones, and produced by Academy Award® nominee Dana Murray (Pixar short "Lou"), SOUL also stars the voice talents of Phylicia Rashad, Questlove and Daveed Diggs. It features original jazz music by globally renowned musician Jon Batiste, with Oscar® winners Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross from Nine Inch Nails composing an original score that drifts between the real and soul worlds.

title: Stranger Than Paradise
overview: A couple of East Village loafers decide to embark on a road trip to Ohio to re-team up with one of their female cousins.

title: Strange Frequencies: Taiwan Killer Hospital
overview: As part of a live-streamed ghost hunt, seven celebrities explore a decaying, haunted hospital and discover a demonic evil worse than they ever imagined.

q: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
overview: A vengeful barber (Johnny Depp) applies his razor to unlucky customers.

title: Like Stars on Earth
overview: When daydreamer Ishaan is sent to boarding school, an unconventional art teacher tries to help the imaginative student discover his true identity.

title: Taken
overview: Ex-C.I.A. agent becomes a one-man killing machine after his daughter is kidnapped.

title: Tampopo
overview: Culinary art and comedy blend together as a trucker helps a fledgling noodle shop owner craft the ultimate ramen recipe. Amidst their journey, quirky vignettes celebrate emotional ties shared with food that transform a simple meal into a life experience.

title: The Drama
overview: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails. Zendaya and Robert Pattinson star in this film written and directed by Kristoffer Borgli.

title: The Endless
overview: Two brothers must re-examine their belief systems when they get a message to revisit the end-of-days UFO death cult they escaped from 10 years ago.

q: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
overview: Makoto is nearly hit by a train when, at the last second, she finds herself jumping backwards in time. She makes use of her newfound ability by re-doing every minor inconvenience in her life. But when faced with the consequences of tampering with time, Makoto must avoid a dire future that can't be reversed. A beloved early film from Academy Award nominee Mamoru Hosoda.

title: The Good Dinosaur
overview: Disney•Pixar presents a hilariously heartwarming adventure into the world of dinosaurs. A young apatosaurus named Arlo makes an unlikely human friend, and learns what he’s truly capable of..

title: The Invite
overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbours for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: The Long Walk
overview: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

title: The Man with Two Brains
overview: A brain surgeon's intense love for a disembodied human brain sends him on a whirlwind search for a body to hold it.

title: The Notebook
overview: In the 1940s, teenaged debutante Allie Hamilton and local boy Noah Calhoun spend one passionate, carefree summer together and fall deeply in love.

title: The Station Agent
overview: A loner with a passion for trains inherits an empty train station in the middle of nowhere. He encounters unexpected neighbors and with absolutely nothing in common, they form a friendship none of them could foresee.

title: The Summit of the Gods
overview: A photojournalist’s obsessive quest for the truth about the first expedition to Mt. Everest leads him to search for an esteemed climber who went missing.

title: The Taste of Tea
overview: Filmmaker Katsuhito Ishii takes a break from the post-Tarantino excess of such highly-stylized outings as Shark Skin Man and Peach Hip Girl for this low-key look at an eccentric family residing in a quiet countryside town just north of Tokyo. The Haruno family is a five-piece clan living the simple life in Japan. The summer sun shining gently down, this quiet quintet is transformed into a six-piece when urban-dwelling uncle Ayano (Tadanobu Asano), a successful music producer, arrives to visit his family and confront his feelings for the ex-girlfriend who married another man after Ayano moved to the city. As the lazy days pass by, each member of the family is followed in a series of episodic vignettes.

title: The Village
overview: An idyllic village is threatened by creatures in the woods nearby.

q: The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar
title: The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar
overview: From Wes Anderson comes this Oscar-winning adaptation of Roald Dahl's short story about a rich gambler who masters an astonishing skill to cheat at cards.

title: Thrash
overview: Surviving the storm is just the beginning. Trapped by a massive hurricane, residents of a coastal town must escape rising waters — and ravenous sharks.

title: Tramps
overview: Pulled into a shady briefcase swap for different reasons, young strangers Danny and Ellie spend an eventful night together when the deal goes wrong.

title: Triangle
overview: After a small group’s yacht capsizes in a sudden storm, rescue comes from Aeolus—a seemingly deserted ocean liner full of confounding paradoxes.

title: Turtles All the Way Down
overview: A teenager with OCD tries to solve a mystery surrounding a fugitive billionaire.

title: Turtles Can Fly
overview: In this haunting film, Kurdish children organize to clear minefields for trade on the eve of the American invasion of Iraq. This drama was the official Iranian entry for the 2004 Academy Awards. From IFC Films.

title: Upgrade
overview: Grey Trace, a technophobe in a utopian near-future when computers control nearly everything - from cars to crime-surveillance - is paralysed in a freak mugging that leaves his wife dead. But when a billionaire technologist offers him an experimental paralysis cure - an implanted computer chip called STEM - Grey finds that the chip has a voice and a mind of its own.

title: Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust
overview: A legendary dhampir competes with a motley family of bounty hunters to return a young woman, who has been seemingly abducted by a vampire, to her family.

title: Watching the Detectives
overview: A film noir obsessive's life is turned upside down when he meets a modern-day femme fatale who pulls him into a series of chaotic adventures

overview: The residents of a small rural town discover that a demon is about to be born among them. They desperately try to escape before the evil is born, but it may be too late.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
overview: Harry and Sally are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: Your Name.
overview: Two teenagers dream they are living opposite lives, but realize they are actually switching places.
